There's a machine that generates random 1s and 0s - no program, no pattern, pure chance, like flipping a coin a billion times.

Researchers ran it over and over. It never landed 50/50 - always 49.9 to 50.1, like clockwork.

Then they had someone simply want more 1s than 0s.

Kevin Trudeau says the number jumped to 50.9, 51, even 52 percent - an anomaly so far outside the range that it happened every time they repeated it.

If a machine with no feelings bends toward what someone wants, what is your own mindset doing to your results?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #scienceofluck #mindsetmatters #quantumfield

A machine ran a billion random 1s and 0s with nobody in the room. Finished. Results locked in, untouched.

Then researchers brought in a person and asked what they wanted more of. The person said zeros.

Kevin Trudeau says they checked results that already existed before the person spoke - and the machine had given more zeros. Every time they repeated it, whatever the person wanted, the finished results matched.

Not influence during the test. Influence on something already over.

If the outcome was already set and it still matched, how random is your own luck, really?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #scienceofluck #zeropointfield #mindsetmatters

In the mid-1970s, a young Kevin Trudeau stood in a school gym packed with a hundred kids for a Boy Scout raffle with three prizes.

Before a single name was called, he says he'd already decided he'd won - putting out what he calls the theta brainwave and holding the outcome in his mind as done.

First prize: not him. Second prize: not him. He stood up before they even opened the third envelope.

They called his name. He says he knew before he heard a single syllable.

That's the moment he says he learned luck isn't random - it's directed.

Have you ever known something was yours before it was announced?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #scienceofluck #mindsetmatters #theta

Researchers took DNA from a person's body and placed it in a Petri dish in another room, Kevin Trudeau says, in a study he credits to the US Army.

They showed the person violent war images. The DNA in their body contracted. So did the DNA alone in the dish, with no physical connection between them.

Then they moved the dish across the planet, inside a lead-lined room that blocks even cell signals.

Same result, instantly, in both places - violent images contracted it, peaceful images expanded it. No time delay, no distance limit.

If your own DNA responds like that, what are your daily thoughts doing to your body right now?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #quantumfield #scienceofluck #mindbody
